newsitem.title: UK: Semple Cochrane raises 4.5 mln stg in flotation.
newsitem.headline: Semple Cochrane raises 4.5 mln stg in flotation.

text.p: Engineering services group Semple Cohcrane Plc has successfully raised 4.5 million stg through flotation, placing 2.5 million ordinary shares priced at 180 pence apiece, it said on Wednesday.
The company will have a market capitalisation of 14 million stg, based on the placing price and is due to see its shares start trading on December 2.

The group aims to grow organically and through "strategic acquisition of complementary skills and technology." Its main business areas are facilities management and support, systems engineering and building services.
